summary: Amarc Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Tom McMillan as Vice President, Investor Relations, effective May 11, 2026. No deal terms, prices, or premiums are stated. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special situation; it is a routine disclosure of a management appointment in preparation for the 2026 exploration program. The registrant is the issuer reporting under the Exchange Act. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. This is a non-US filer reporting on Form 6-K, equivalent to a US 8-K for material events, but the event is not a special situation. The filing is neutral and provides no risk-arb angle.
